turnos.pregunta: Two-storey stairwell, old paper on it, probably needs removing first.
consultas: Two-storey stairwell, old paper on it, probably needs removing first.
turnos.respuesta:
That's the part nobody can call from a photo — how old paper comes off depends on what it is and what's underneath. Strippable papers can come away in whole lengths; older or painted-over layers can pull the surface with them and turn up repair work that wasn't visible.

Which is why a look in person settles it. Want me to pass your details along when you're ready?
